title: Pointwise images of scheme fibre-product projections and maps
statement: Let $X,Y,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to S$, $g:Y\to S$, and $P=X\times_SY$ with projections $p_X,p_Y$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then $\operatorname{im}(|p_Y|)=|g|^{-1}(\operatorname{im}(|f|))$. Furthermore, let $X^{\prime},Y^{\prime}$ be schemes, $f^{\prime}:X^{\prime}\to S$, $g^{\prime}:Y^{\prime}\to S$, and $a:X\to X^{\prime}$, $b:Y\to Y^{\prime}$ satisfy $f^{\prime}a=f$ and $g^{\prime}b=g$. Write $P^{\prime}=X^{\prime}\times_SY^{\prime}$, with projections $p_X^{\prime},p_Y^{\prime}$. The induced map $h=a\times_Sb:P\to P^{\prime}$ satisfies $\operatorname{im}(|h|)=|p_X^{\prime}|^{-1}(\operatorname{im}(|a|))\cap|p_Y^{\prime}|^{-1}(\operatorname{im}(|b|))$. All images are images of underlying point sets; no finiteness or flatness assumption is imposed.
